globalSettings.negativePromptCommon: text, letters, Korean characters, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermarks, chalk writing, calligraphy, labels, extra characters, 3D render, photorealistic, distorted hands, deformed face, blurry, low quality
globalSettings.compositionRule: Keep Seolmin as the same 2D Korean teacher from the approved keyframe set. Keep the teacher on the right quarter and keep the board empty for later typography.

providerExpectations.keyframeGate: Approve all five keyframes before any scene video generation begins.
providerExpectations.pictureStage: Generate mute picture-only clips first, then hand off for picture lock, dub, and typography.
providerExpectations.continuityRule: Scene 1 starts from approved keyframe 01; scenes 2-5 start from the previous scene final frame and aim toward the approved next keyframe pose card.
providerExpectations.textRule: Do not bake Korean, romanization, English, CTA, or answer text into generated frames.
providerExpectations.sceneDelivery: Each completed scene should yield a picture clip plus an extracted last-frame asset for the next handoff.
